kind: Data-expansion re-score, not a modelling round. The LOI snapshot of record (exp163: 606 rows / 107 papers) plus wave 14: 215 hand-extracted rows from 31 additional open-literature papers read through the Las Positas College library. Same model as exp163 (round-8 average of RF, ExtraTrees, Ridge on the exp092 features) and the exp114 proxy-free sibling, unchanged.
status: report-only for this session. Claude (Arnav's session) does not edit numbers_of_record.json; whether the expanded snapshot becomes the LOI record is the orchestrator's / owner's decision after a fresh critic.
declared: 2026-10-11 by Claude (Arnav's session), committed before any score on the expanded snapshot; git commit time governs. Row extraction used only the papers' own tables/text; no model output of any kind was seen before this declaration.
authority: Arnav (2026-10-11): 'keep harvesting open access papers and once you have a lot you can start training'. Precedents: loi_snapshot_update2 (rows added), wave4/wave5 stages (rescore_loi_snapshot.py --stage). No owner (Nikhilesh S) decision on this wave yet.
banned_moves_note: No model, feature, hyperparameter, seed or fold-rule change. No row of the 606-row snapshot is added, removed or edited. No wave-14 row is dropped, re-weighted or edited after a score (all 215 rows enter, figure-read values were never extracted). One expanded snapshot scored once; not a selection among alternatives. FAA rows not mixed in.

Lignin-POH (W9-002) matches the generic lignin entry (P not counted)

the loading of CPPA (W9-022) was changed from '92.5 wt% of B component' to '100 php' BEFORE any score, because the builder would read the former as a foam wt% (the polyol is the whole polyol component)

procedure: Step 1 (self-test): rescore_loi_snapshot.py with --stage wave4_staging --stage wave5_staging --stage chemfix_staging --stage unitfix_staging --script data/v2/train_loi_rescore_r8.py reproduces exp163 (B 0.4253 [0.2607, 0.5503]) and exp164 within 0.002, else BLOCKED and no expanded score is reported.

Step 2: ONE run of the same command plus --stage data/v2/loi_rpuf_parts/wave14_staging. The script's own outputs are the primary result: exp113-config B mean, paper-bootstrap 95% CI, pooled CI, protocol A and C, exp114 sibling.

Step 3 (report-only, from the saved OOF of step 2, no refit): R2 of the protocol-B OOF predictions restricted to the 606 original rows and, separately, to the 215 wave-14 rows (pooled per repeat, then averaged), plus the paper-bootstrap CI of each subset. A subset R2 is not the record statistic and is never quoted as one.
Step 4: label-free check that no wave-14 row exceeds 60 wt% total FR.
reporting_rules: The expanded snapshot is a different benchmark population from exp163. Its B mean is NOT a like-for-like change in the record model; it is reported next to the exp163 number with that statement.
No 'improved', 'beats' or SOTA wording; comparable stays pending-human. The 0.84 bar is not compared on a different population.
If step 1 fails or any wave-14 row proves wrong on audit, the expanded result is withdrawn, not patched.
acceptance_rule: None applied by this session. The orchestrator decides after a fresh-context critic whether the expanded snapshot replaces exp163 as the LOI population of record; this config only declares and reports.
environment: .venv312 (sklearn 1.7.1, numpy 2.2.6, pandas 2.3.3), as the repo pins.
exit_triggers: Self-test failure -> BLOCKED. B ci_lo > 0.84 or A mean > 0.84 -> FLAG (owner wording), not a win.
honesty_notes: Any change in R2 comes from a larger and different set of papers; it is reported as a data effect, never a modelling gain.
Extraction errors are possible (single extractor, text-layer PDFs). The wave is therefore scored once and labelled unaudited until a second-pass QA is done.
amendment_1: 2026-10-11, after the step-2 score: the saved OOF (loi_rescore_r8_r8d_oof.npz) lived in the throwaway working copy and was deleted, so step 3 could not read it. It reproduced B 0.4588 [0.3162, 0.5472], A 0.740, C 0.335 and all ten per-repeat B values exactly (same seeds), so it is the same score, not a second look. result_2026-10-11.caveats: Different population from exp163, so 0.4588 vs 0.4253 is not a like-for-like model change. The old-only 0.4944 is NOT a paired comparison with 0.4253: fold assignments differ because the group set changed. A paired test (same folds over the 107 original papers, with and without wave 14 in training) was not pre-declared and has not been run. Single extractor, no independent QA of the 215 rows.
